works.title: Ultrasound VR — virtual embellishment of surfaces
works.description: A test from Ultrasound VR in which audio-reactive sound sculptures attach to real walls and floors, embellishing the room's surfaces and pulsing with the music.
works.description_zh: Ultrasound VR 的一段测试：随音频律动的声音雕塑贴附在真实的墙面和地面上，装点房间的各个表面，并随音乐起伏。
works.idea_en: Let music grow on the walls: sound becomes living ornament on real surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 让音乐长在墙上：声音变成附着在真实表面上的活装饰。
works.technique: LiDAR scene reconstruction on Apple Vision Pro gives wall and floor planes; generative meshes are anchored to them and deformed by the audio spectrum in real time.
works.technique_zh: Apple Vision Pro 上的 LiDAR 场景重建提供墙面和地面平面，生成式网格锚定在这些平面上，并实时随音频频谱变形。
works.exercise_en: Detect vertical and horizontal planes with AR Foundation or WebXR, grow a pattern on each surface, and drive its scale or colour with an FFT of the microphone or a music track. Twist: give walls and floors different frequency bands, so the room becomes an equalizer.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 或 WebXR 检测竖直和水平平面，在每个表面上生长出图案，并用麦克风或音乐的 FFT 频谱驱动它的大小或颜色；变体：让墙面和地面分别响应不同的频段，把整个房间变成一台均衡器。
